sources.title: On untouchable numbers and related problems (2012 manuscript; published as Variant of a theorem of Erdos on the sum-of-proper-divisors function,2014)
sources.supports: Parity split, composite square-root bound X^(2/3), near-linear prefix census. Intro strict-upper-bound uncertainty superseded2015.

sources.title: Nonaliquot numbers

sources.title: The range of the sum-of-proper-divisors function
sources.supports: Positive lower proportion of even targets in the image, hence strict upper-density bound for untouchables.

sources.title: Some problems of Erdos on the sum-of-divisors function
sources.supports: Existence of model Delta; equality with actual density conjectural, near0.17 heuristic.

sources.title: Errata to Some problems of Erdos on the sum-of-divisors function

sources.title: Finite connected components of the aliquot graph
sources.supports: Even-target inverse algorithm O_epsilon(m^(1/2+epsilon)); prior hyperbola trick; precise distinctness boundary for Goldbach verification.

sources.title: Numerical and Statistical Analysis of Aliquot Sequences
sources.supports: Published untouchable census to2^40; density model remains a heuristic.
